name: bolivia-tax-optimization
description: Legal ways to pay less tax in Bolivia in 2026, for small traders, professionals and companies, and the lines not to cross. Covers the Régimen Tributario Simplificado (RTS, DS 24484) for retailers, food sellers and artisans: who qualifies (capital up to Bs 60,000, sales up to Bs 184,000, unit-price limits), who is excluded, the six capital categories with fixed bimonthly payments of Bs 47 to Bs 350, the payment dates, the ban on issuing invoices and the duty to hold purchase invoices; the option and the duty to move to the general regime; and, in the general regime, the reliefs that sibling skills hold (the IUE credit against IT, 2026 accelerated depreciation, loss carry-forward, the reinvestment rates on dividends paid abroad, RC-IVA invoice credits and Re-IVA). Red lines: false invoices, wrong regime or category, unbanked payments of Bs 50,000 or more. Trigger on: reduce tax Bolivia, régimen simplificado, RTS Bolivia, small trader tax Bolivia, vivandero, artesano, comerciante minorist
